title: Dicksonia sellowiana
wikitext:
{{Short description|Species of fern}} {{more citations needed|date=July 2018}} {{Speciesbox | image = Dicksonia sellowiana in a Brasilian Forest.jpg | genus = Dicksonia | species = sellowiana | authority = [[William Jackson Hooker|Hook.]] }} '''''Dicksonia sellowiana''''', the '''xaxim''', or '''samambaiaçu''' or '''imperial samambaiaçu''', is an arborescent [[fern]] in the family [[Dicksoniaceae]], native to the tropical and [[Subtropics|subtropical]]{{Cite web |title=Establishing a secure connection ... |url=https://www.scielo.br/j/abb/a/y5pf9fDGP7h6w8BpKK4TkxK/?lang=en |access-date=2025-09-17 |website=www.scielo.br |doi=10.1590/0102-33062020abb0234}} [[Americas]]. ==Distribution== The fern is native to Southern [[Mexico]], [[Central America]], and [[South America]]. In the South American [[Atlantic Forest]] biome, it is found in: [[Southeastern Brazil]] in the states of [[Minas Gerais]], [[Rio de Janeiro (state)|Rio de Janeiro]], [[São Paulo (state)|São Paulo]], [[Paraná (state)|Paraná]], [[Santa Catarina (state)|Santa Catarina]], and [[Rio Grande do Sul]]; in northeast of [[Argentina]] within [[Misiones Province]]; and in eastern [[Paraguay]]. ==Description== ''Dicksonia sellowiana'' has an erect and cylindrical [[caudex]], reaching sometimes more than {{convert|10|m}} high, the [[frond]]s are [[bipinnate]] and {{convert|2|m|abbr=on}} long. Due to illegal extraction, the species is at risk of [[extinction]].{{Cite web |title=Equipo Humano |url=http://www.floraargentina.edu.ar/equipo/ |access-date=2026-08-18 |website=Flora Argentina |language=es-AR}} ===Varieties=== Dicksonia sellowiana is variable in its form.
